vsm1.4:10.1: 1. “They say it is the Dakkhiṇagiri in the Magadha country” (Vism-mhṭ 116). There is mention of a Dakkhiṇagiri-vihāra at M-a II 293 and elsewhere.
vsm1.4:13.3: 2. Read pamukhesu sosayanti. Pamukha not thus in PED.
vsm1.4:15.1: 3. “A ‘water port of entry’ is a port of entry on the sea or on an estuary. A ‘land port of entry’ is one on the edge of a forest and acts as the gateway on the road of approach to great cities” (Vism-mhṭ 116).
